blocks.text: DAVAO CITY, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday accused now-dismissed policeman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. of weaponizing his anger against former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco to tear down her political reputation. In a press conference here, Duterte read from a prepared statement to refute the allegations contained in a Sept. 14 affidavit of Gracioso, a former security aide of Velasco, who claimed to have delivered cash payoffs to her at least 10 times from 2018 to 2020. Duterte showed screenshots of her conversation with Velasco, who is still out of the country with his wife, Rowena, about what could […]...
